title: AS2: global startDrag(target) with 1 arg (and 3-5 args) crashes the compiler
description: packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts:2434-2458 branches on args.length===0, >=2&&<6, and else (assumes 6-arg constrain form, reads args[2..5]). args.length===1 falls into else and calls compileExpr(expr.args[2]!) where args[2] is undefined -> 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading type)'. Verified: 'startDrag(_root.mc);' throws. Any 3-5 arg form (not exactly 6) hits the same out-of-bounds. Method form mc.startDrag(...) uses the generic CallMethod path and is unaffected (why tests miss it). NOTE: distinct from done tasks 1127/1128 (startDrag stack order / built-in emit). Fix: guard the constrain branch on args.length>=6; handle 1-arg (target only) and 2-5-arg forms explicitly. Confidence: confirmed.
